officialText:
(a) beams, floor slabs, or other building construction making an angle less than 75 deg with the horizontal shall not project more than 50 mm (2 in) inside the hoistway enclosure unless the top surface of the projection is beveled at an angle not less than 75 deg with the horizontal

(c) where recesses or setbacks exceeding 50 mm (2 in) occur in the enclosure wall, the top of the recess or setback shall be beveled at an angle of not less than 75 deg with the horizontal
